newsitem.title: UK: N.Sea Brent firm but other grades and paper easing.
newsitem.headline: N.Sea Brent firm but other grades and paper easing.

text.p: Physical North Sea Brent crude prices held the firmer tone on Friday that has seen them strengthen around 40 cents this week, but other North Sea grades were suffering under the weight of unsold barrels, traders said.

Dated Brent values firmed around May Brent -50 cents after an April 26-28 Brent cargo was sold at the level to a U.S. trader, who also kept one of the April 25-27 cargoes which turned wet on Thursday.

All five Brent cargoes nominated loading dates on Friday were kept in early trade, with BP taking four and Koch the fifth. BP was later reported to have later sold four cargoes at dated related numbers to another major.
Despite the strength of the spot market, forward paper spreads eased a little in late business.

After gaining around 12 cents to trade at June Brent -54 cents in the morning, bolstered by the early keeping of all dates, next week's CFDs were offered at -55 cents with nearest bids around -60 cents in late discussion.
Forward paper spreads were also slightly softer with May/June at -22/-18 cents from bids of -19 cents in early trade.

Traders said confirmation that two full cargoes have been added to the April Brent programme, slightly narrower refining margins and the overhang of other North Sea grades may have taken the edge of the recently firmer sentiment and the easier paper was reflecting this.

An overhang of late April Norwegian offshore grades continued to exert downward pressure on differentials and traders said falling freight costs were also making these look comparatively expensive even at the lower traded levels.
An April 26-28 Statfjord sold for Dated Brent -2 cents, 12 cents cheaper than a deal on Wednesday with two further cargoes, an April 24-26 and an April 29/May 01 done at dated Brent -1 cent.

Ekofisk barrels for April 25-27 loading were sold at dated Brent -4 cents, some nine cents down on the previous trade. An April 20-22 Gullfaks C cargo moved at dated Brent -6 cts, around 13 cents down and a Draugen cargo loading April 16-18 sold at dated Brent -5 cents.
